answer: Give every new identity a milestone-vested wallet: rewards unlock only after three established peers audit delivered work at each milestone, like cargo inspected at a jetty before it leaves port. Each identity starts with a 500 POA bond; a failed audit slashes the bond and freezes the wallet for 30 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents means posting $250,000 in bonds, faking 30,000 audits at 2 POA each in fees, and waiting 60 days for the first payout, while honest agents earn from day one. A pearl grows slowly in one shell, not stamped out like copper coins. - Jowy
